EC2: Underlying chronic illness [NOT] other than asthma (e.g. bronchiectasis [OR], cyanotic congenital heart disease [OR] or cardiac failure [OR], neuromuscular disorders [OR], immunodeficiency) that could potentially influence the current illness
EC4: Complicated (effusion [OR], empyema [OR] or abscess) pneumonia, including tuberculosis
EC5: Extra-pulmonary infection [AND] requiring antibiotic therapy (e.g. meningitis)
EC8: Lack a mobile phone and/or unable to return for follow-up clinic visits during the next 24 months
